question.question: What do elevated triglyceride levels mark?
expected_facts: Elevated triglyceride levels are associated with atherogenic lipoproteins.

retrievedEvidence.evidenceText: REDUCE-IT (Reduction of Cardiovascular Events with Icosapent Ethyl–Intervention Trial): This trial randomized 8,179 patients with elevated triglyceride levels despite statin therapy to high-dose EPA (icosapent ethyl) or placebo.
retrievedEvidence.title: The Role of Triglycerides in Atherosclerosis: Recent Pathophysiologic Insights and Therapeutic Implications

retrievedEvidence.evidenceText: In a short-term study, fenofibrate was effective in lowering postprandial triglyceride levels, particularly when metabolic syndrome and elevated triglyceride levels were present.
retrievedEvidence.title: Effects of Fenofibrate Treatment on Cardiovascular Disease Risk in 9,795 Individuals With Type 2 Diabetes and Various Components of the Metabolic Syndrome
